content: For EmotionPush, the text are informal chats which including like slang, acronym, typo, hyperlink, and emoji. Another characteristic is that the specific name entities are tokenized with random index. (e.g. “organization_80”, “person_01”, and “time_12”). We consider some of these informal text are related to expressing emotion such as repeated typing, purposed capitalization, and emoji (e.g. “:D”, “:(”, and “<3”)). Therefore, we keep most informal expressions but only process hyperlinks, empty utterance, and name entities by unifying the tokens.
